title: István Bibó: The Misery of Small States
goal: I can say how much fear changes a community with *számottevően* or *alapjaiban*.
I can read a short original text about Bibó István and his 1946 study.
I can use the main words of the reading: *kisállami nyomorúság*, *kórtünet*, *polgári bátorság*.
